gates.name: production docs build
gates.reason: docs.ps1 does not exist in this working copy. Per this repository's own convention (CLAUDE.md, 'Docs Site'), docs.ps1 is generated by Invoke-SetupDocs during kit installation and is not committed — it was never installed in this checkout. Cannot run ./docs.ps1 -BuildOnly without it; the corresponding 'Verify Documentation Build' check on the pull request is where the real answer comes from.

gates.name: host tests
gates.reason: dotnet test src/host/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests.csproj fails at NuGet restore: 'error NU1301: Failed to retrieve information about SubZeroDev.Platform.Hosting from remote source https://nuget.pkg.github.com/The-Running-Dev/download/subzerodev.platform.hosting/index.json — Response status code does not indicate success: 401 (Unauthorized).' This package is published from the sibling SubZeroDev.Platform repository and needs a cross-repo read:packages token (host-image.yml calls this REGISTRY_TOKEN) that is not configured in this local environment. The 'engine' required check does not cover src/host/; the host-image workflow's own CI run is where this actually gets verified.

gates.name: host image smoke
gates.reason: host-image.yml's own first step ('Verify NuGet restore credential is configured') fails the job outright without a REGISTRY_TOKEN secret, and its 'Test the host' step needs the same cross-repo GitHub Packages credential that made 'host tests' fail above (NU1301 401 Unauthorized restoring SubZeroDev.Platform.Hosting). Also needs a Docker build/run/smoke sequence pulling ghcr.io/the-running-dev/docs-template, which was not attempted once the restore precondition was already known to fail. The host-image workflow's own CI run on the pull request is where this gets verified.
